sector.description: the sector as the owner named it, plus the reading you took when it was ambiguous

quiet.description: true when no deal passed the checks: deals is then empty

company.description: the company raising, bought, listing or closing; for a new fund, the fund's manager

date.description: the event's date, not the article's

amount.description: the figure with its currency, or the word undisclosed. Never an estimate

amount_basis.description: who gave the figure when it is not the company, such as per PitchBook or reported by Reuters

lead.description: the lead investor or the acquirer, named as the primary source names them, or the word undisclosed

terms.description: valuation, multiple, cash and stock mix, earn-outs, when disclosed; null otherwise

rationale.description: the stated reason, attributed to whoever stated it in the same string

source_url.description: the press release, filing or decision page, never an index or a search page

watch_next.description: one dated thing to watch: a pricing date, a regulator deadline, an expected close; null when there is none

report_markdown.description: the digest a person reads: the biggest deal first, then deals grouped as rounds, M&A, listings, exits, with numbers first. A quiet week is a header and one line
